description: PAUSED: Growtsy can't read Etsy's API right now (since 19 November 2026); this tool returns the error etsy_offline — don't retry it. Instead: the seller uploads the listings CSV Etsy lets them download at the shop audit page (see the error's alternatives); for one listing, etsy_listing_text_check. When Etsy access returns: Reads up to 100 active listings of an Etsy shop from Etsy's API and checks each one against Etsy's published title, tag and photo rules. Returns the shop's first problem and how many listings have it, per-listing issues, and Etsy's shop sales count (the shop's lifetime total, not per listing). Use for 'why is my Etsy shop not getting sales?' and 'what should I fix first?'.

shop.description: Etsy shop name or shop link
